applicable_to: Hotels, motels, inns, similar lodging businesses
required_topics: Introduction to Child Trafficking in Connecticut
Introduction to Human Trafficking in Connecticut for Law Enforcement
Introduction to Human Trafficking in Connecticut for Emergency Medical Services
Child Trafficking Training for Medical Providers/Emergency Medicine
Introduction to Labor Trafficking in Connecticut
recordkeeping_requirements: guest transactions and receipts for at least six months
law_references: An Act Strengthening Protections for Victims of Human Trafficking (2015)
An Act Concerning the Department of Children and Families and the Protection of Children (2014)
An Act Concerning Sexual Exploitation and Trafficking in Persons (2013)
Commercial Sexual Exploitation of a Minor (2012)
Notification by the Deparment of Children and Families When a Youth is Arrested for Prostitution (2011)
An Act Providing a Safe Harbor for Exploited Children (2010)
risks_or_constraints: Lodging businesses must comply with annual trafficking training and recordkeeping requirements
